newsitem.title: USA: Grand Coulee 700 MW turbine shut for rest of year.
newsitem.headline: Grand Coulee 700 MW turbine shut for rest of year.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) turbine 23 at the massive Grand Coulee hydropower dam in Washington state was taken off line early Thursday for scheduled repair work through the remainder of the year, a manager at the dam said Thursday.
Meanwhile, the dam's 700 MW turbine 24 was returned to service Thursday after being taken off line earlier in the week for unplanned repairs.
In addition, Grand Coulee's 600 MW turbine 21 is scheduled to resume operations later Thursday, completing a scheduled maintenance and repair outage which began in February.

Outflows from Grand Coulee, which has a total rated capacity of 6,150 MW, have continued to taper off this week amid re-filling of the reservoir ahead of August fish flow requirements, the project manager said.
On Wednesday, flows from Grand Coulee average 119,000 cubic feet per second (cfs), down from 147,000 cfs on Monday.
